description: This file defines the WebSocketRouteDispatcher class responsible for managing WebSocket route interactions within a Playwright-based testing framework. It handles events, connections, message forwarding, and integration with BrowserContext and Page dispatchers.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing WebSocket routes, including event handling, connection management, message passing, and cleanup.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the WebSocket route by exposing bindings and initializing the dispatcher for a given page or browser context.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes the WebSocket route and cleans up associated bindings and scripts from the target.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Handles the connection request to the WebSocket route.

methods.name: ensureOpened
methods.description: Ensures the WebSocket connection is open.

methods.name: sendToPage
methods.description: Sends a message from the server to the page through the WebSocket route.

methods.name: sendToServer
methods.description: Sends a message from the page to the server through the WebSocket route.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket route from the page side.

methods.name: closeServer
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket route from the server side.

methods.name: _evaluateAPIRequest
methods.description: Helper method to evaluate and dispatch WebSocket API requests within the frame context.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup and removal of dispatcher references upon disposal.

methods.name: _executionContextGone
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the associated execution context (like page or frame) is gone.
